method: Local disposable Redis + Node containers on a private bridge. Synthetic JSON sizes match measured DTO bytes. Unexpired hits, persistent TCP, no TLS/authentication/revision SQL/browser/business data. Node uses the real local cache implementation. Each typical case/mode has three rounds of 100 samples; order rotates. Preencoded modes are alternative serving designs, not the current API implementation.

oversized.shape: One synthetic large string, not the real monthly Map/Date/object graph. Three samples per timing; exploratory only and excluded from normal-cache comparisons.

environment.persistence: disabled only in this disposable study cache; app backups unchanged

interpretation.scope: Component microbenchmark on local Docker, not VPS or app integrated with Redis. Synthetic shapes/bytes, persistent connection, no TLS or concurrent load. No integrated Redis page latency claim.
interpretation.comparability: Compare localCurrentDto to redisDto, or localPreencoded to redisPreencoded. Comparing redisPreencoded with localCurrentDto also changes serialization and cannot attribute gain to Redis.
interpretation.ttl: 60 seconds for unexpired-hit component test; actual app response TTL is at most 15 seconds
interpretation.memory: Typical entries used 64MiB maxmemory. Oversized stress first refused SET with OOM, evicted four normal keys, then raised only this disposable Redis to 128MiB. Container limit remained 256MiB. This is not a recommendation to increase app cache entry budgets.
interpretation.oversized: Only three samples, one large string, no p95 acceptance or equivalence with real Map/Date monthly graph
interpretation.decision: No evidence to add Redis for the current single HTTP process. Reconsider shared compact versioned DTO cache if API replicas, repeated cold deployments, or measured cross-process reuse justify it.
interpretation.cleanup: Disposable Redis and Node containers/private internal network removed; no host ports or business data; app dependencies, deployments, backups and existing Redis services untouched
